learnings: Transient API errors (HTTP 400, empty responses) should trigger automatic retries before marking a file inconclusive; the tool should distinguish 'could not assess' from 'assessed and uncertain'

Content-safety filters on free-tier models can misclassify benign technical content (bash scripts, license text) as unsafe; the audit tool should either use models without aggressive content filters or add retry logic that strips/ignores content-safety wrapper responses

When all successfully-assessed files are marked safe and inconclusives are purely due to tool errors, the aggregator should recognize this pattern and return 'safe' rather than propagating the tool failure as an inconclusive verdict
